name: xySat Worker
description: Installs the xyOps xySat worker and supervises it with s6-overlay.

version.description: xySat release version to install. `latest` installs the current release.

serviceUser.description: User account that runs xySat and its jobs. Automatic selection prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.

conductorUrl.description: Base URL of the xyOps conductor used for automatic first-start registration.

apiKeyFile.description: Runtime-mounted file containing an xyOps API key with only the `add_servers` privilege.
